title:
Comment of Bonnie Gantz in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/19/2026

documents.name: 151688.txt
documents.text:
Bonnie Gantz, Readfield, ME.
I am writing tonight to ask that the underwater data center in Maine’s Bay of Fundy is rejected. This area is a necessary for the endangered North Atlantic right whale.

Data centers are a plight on democracy and the environment. The citizens of Maine do not want them in the warming waters of the Bay.

Thank you for your time and attention.
